This README describes the bounded migration in this branch. The owner accepted the Vault ADR on 30 September 2026; it is merged into Vault main. Governance-pack publication and further implementation remain separate work. UIF remains separate from UILib and the official TUI Design System.

Durable decision: UIF-VLT / adr.token-model-and-figma-projection · Status: accepted · Owner-approved 30 September 2026 · Merged into Vault main.
Runtime contract and reproducible evidence: UIF-RUN / figma/migrations/token-model-2026-09-30/.

The bounded slice preserves IDs, WEB syntax and existing visual values. Recorded legacy exceptions include literal Pattern slots and code-only projections. Broader palette repair, component geometry changes, releases and Figma library publication are separate work.

Vault and Runtime remain distinct responsibilities. This document is a Figma projection of the Vault decision, not a second governance source.
